review_method: Human-readable visual inspection by primary agent of actual sole reference, four-view composite, threequarter, and six FK poses; no automated aesthetic acceptance.
retained_features: No independent head/neck; ivory wedge torso
Three-link side-view Z legs, lateral splay and low wide feet
Ivory rear shell and blue service panel
Original image proportions prioritized over unverified width header
unclosed_visual_deviations: Shoulder armor curvature remains too rounded/simplified
Chest top/side connections and vent cassettes differ from reference; current cassettes protrude
Hip/knee mechanical layering, palms and toe/sole layering too simplified
TOP panel camera pose/scale in source drawing uncalibrated; no claimed exact depth reconstruction
observed_pose_risks: Low reach places palms close to knee armor
Single-support raised foot approaches support foot
Discrete FK images do not approve continuous sweeps or contact
required_before_appearance_release: Refine source shells against sole reference and inspect same-source views; do not relabel proxy as original design or change major silhouette without presenting conflict.
